title: Map — Give me list of all design prototypes in html

messages.content:
Give me list of all design prototypes in html

(Answering inside the brain-map view: mention the exact repo-relative paths of every relevant file so the map can highlight them.)

Here are the HTML design prototypes in the repo (excluding `.claude/worktrees/` clones and the CRS Brain app's own UI files like `crs-brain/public/*`):

**Demos / interactive prototypes** — `demos/`
- `demos/CRS_Canvas.html` — main UI canvas prototype
- `demos/CRS_Coming_Soon.html` — `#GR - Coming Soon` placeholder screen
- `demos/CRS_BreakList.html` — Break List module prototype
- `demos/casino_property_settings.html` — property settings screen
- `demos/casino_property_settings (2).html` — variant/copy of the above

**Design system** — `design/`
- `design/CRS_UI_Kit.html` — the UI kit / component reference

**Specs / blueprint** — `specs/`
- `specs/CRS_Blueprint.html` — generated blueprint spec (roadmap table)
- `specs/CRS_Blueprint_Source.html` — source variant
- `specs/Blueprint_Clear_Picture.html` — "clear picture" overview spec

**Brain-generated docs** — `crs-brain/data/docs/`
- `crs-brain/data/docs/buttons.html` — button component demo

Excluded as non-prototypes: `crs-brain/public/index.html` and `crs-brain/public/map.html` (the CRS Brain app shell itself), and every path under `.claude/worktrees/charming-allen-8a0e18/` (duplicate working-tree copies).

Want me to open or screenshot any of these, or spin up a new prototype under `crs-brain/data/docs/`?
